name: dsh-conversation-folders
description: DSH 插件：每个会话一个专属文件夹 + 对话记录存档 + 空闲后自动分类归档 + 菜单内删除对话。首次使用会话时在工作区下创建以对话标题命名的文件夹（标题未就绪时先用 `会话-<短ID>`，空闲后自动改名），把会话工作目录指过去（对话产生的所有文件都落在里面），并自动把对话内容写入 `对话记录.md`；对话结束、长时间没有新任务后，才把新增的表格、图表、文档等文件按类别分文件夹存放并自动命名（`调研<N>_<原名>`），对话进行中文件保持原位、可随时查看；会话「…」菜单里提供「删除对话及其内容」，删除会话时连同文件夹及全部内容彻底删除。| DSH plugin: one dedicated folder per conversation (named after the conversation title), transcript archiving, idle-time auto-categorization, and a delete action in the session menu. On first use, creates a folder in the workspace and redirects the conversation working directory into it, writing the transcript to `对话记录.md`; only after the conversation has been idle for a while are loose files (tables, charts, documents, ...) moved into category subfolders with automatic names (`调研<N>_<original>`), so files stay in place and viewable while the conversation is active; a "Delete conversation and its contents" row in the session menu permanently removes the conversation, its folder, and everything inside.
